current_full_gate_snapshot.limitation: Freshness and pass/fail are derived at read time; this document does not duplicate mutable receipt status.

red: active spec left the chart-series decision unresolved after the ADR had confirmed it
acceptance evidence was configured to the iteration-only fast gate
same-status mutation under an excluded protected path was not rejected
FR-005 headings, canonical links, decision state, and release readiness had no semantic aggregate contract
green: semantic document contract enforces all six FR-005 headings, canonical entry links, and one confirmed chart decision
acceptance executes the current full S6 gate under an unambiguous receipt id while fast stays iteration-only
metadata-only sentinels reject validation-time mutation under data, secret, and sample exclusions without reading file content
read-only fail-closed status aggregates evidence freshness, token integrity, external approval, strict tracking, maintainer state, and deployment binding

result_source: Acceptance reruns the configured command and retains stdout/stderr so their digests can be recomputed. Local files provide reproducibility, not trusted authenticity or human approval.
